name: segment-bar
title: Segment Bar
description: A segmented control in a rounded panel whose pill glides to the pick, with an action button that pops.

perf.budget: The pill moves with one UI-thread spring per change; at rest nothing animates.

a11y.reducedMotion: The pill jumps to the selection and the action button does not pop.
a11y.screenReader: A radio group with a name; each option is a radio with its checked state; the action button has its own name.
a11y.touchTarget: Options and the action button are at least 44 pt.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { SegmentBar } from '@/components/kinetik/segment-bar';

<SegmentBar
  label="File format"
  options={[
    { value: 'png', label: 'png' },
    { value: 'jpg', label: 'jpg' },
    { value: 'heic', label: 'heic' },
  ]}
  value={format}
  onChange={setFormat}
  action={{ icon: <DownloadIcon />, label: 'Save image', onPress: save }}
/>;
```

## When to use

- Two to four short options that change how the next action behaves, like a format before saving.
- Mode switches in an editor panel.

## When not to use

- Navigation between screens: use tabs.
- Long labels or more than four options: use a select.

## Notes

- `value` is typed from your options, so `onChange` hands back the same union.
- The action button is optional and pops when pressed.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add segment-bar`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
